name: Heat Jaws
bodyType: Anglerfish torso on a fiery Pyronite frame

debut.episode: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray

abilities: Pyrokinesis - flames that grow stronger after he submerges in water
Ripjaws' steel-shearing jaws and unhinging mouth
Underwater breathing and underwater heat generation
weaknesses: Dehydrates on land extremely fast (Piscciss Volann half needs water while the Pyronite half radiates heat)
Pyrokinesis takes great effort in or out of water
summary: Ripjaws' torso on Heatblast's burning limbs - a fish that breathes fire underwater, and the fusion that ended Animo's mutant-ray mess.
traits: Ripjaws' back fin replaced by a line of fire
Designer Thomas N. Perkins IV wanted a more blended take
notableFeats: Defeated Heatbat, the Mutant Frog and Dr. Animo, restored Max and fixed the Omnitrix (Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray)

appearances.firstEpisode: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
notableEpisodes: Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
appearances.designNotes: Ripjaws' grey anglerfish torso and head with Heatblast's rocky, flaming arms and legs; a line of fire replaces the dorsal fin.

scoring.rationale: Combines Heatblast's fire (boosted underwater) with Ripjaws' bite and swimming, and he single-handedly beat every Animo mutant in his episode; but he dries out even faster than Ripjaws and his fire is hard to sustain.

notes: Fusion of Heatblast + Ripjaws (componentIds); one-episode OS accident.
